doTitle: What you do with this page
doSteps: Learn the four words: domain, pack, extract, oath.
Do not map them onto expedition recall — different stage, different stakes.
When delves ship, provision deliberately before you enter.
doNote: Stop when oath ≠ pact tribute. Parent stage: [the Delve](delve).

mixUps.q: Is a pack an expedition slot?
mixUps.a: No. Packs are for the Delve room graph. Expeditions stay idle dispatch.

mixUps.q: Are oaths the same as pacts?
mixUps.a: No. Pacts are roster loyalty. Oaths are optional hard delve stakes.
No. Not finished / not playable yet.

mixUps.q: Does wipe always mean nothing happens?
mixUps.a: Vision failure branches can open new content from loss — see [failure branches](failure-branches).
